title: CPU vertex decode computes the bitangent sign with the triple-product operands swapped
expected_finding: bitangent_sign computes sign(dot(dP/dU, cross(N, dP/dV))) = +1 for this quad, where the canonical sign(dot(dP/dV, cross(N, dP/dU))) is -1; the shader's B = tangent.w * cross(N, T) then points along -V (world +Y) instead of +V (world -Y), so the normal map's green channel is applied inverted (the surface leans away from the light)
